title: medicago italica var. muricata
intro: Medicago italica var. muricata, commonly known as red clover, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is rich in isoflavones and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing menopausal symptoms, alleviating osteoporosis, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of red clover are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic properties, which may also contribute to its potential in preventing certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Medicago italica var. muricata include isoflavones, particularly formononetin and genistein, as well as other compounds such as coumarins and phenolic acids.
